items.en: Russia shows drone interceptor derived from Alazan anti-hail rocket at Chebarkul exhibition toured by Putin

items.sEn: A guided interceptor based on the civilian Alazan anti-hail rocket was displayed at a weapons exhibition at the Chebarkul training range in the Urals on 2 October 2026, which Vladimir Putin toured, Euromaidan Press reports, drawing on an original report and analysis by the Ukrainian outlet Militarnyi. items.en: russia Developing New $12,000 Surface-to-Air Missile to Counter Drones: What Is Known, What Could Its Specifications Be? (Defense Express)
items.nl: Rusland ontwikkelt nieuwe luchtdoelraket van $12.000 tegen drones: wat bekend is en wat de specificaties kunnen zijn (Defense Express)
items.sEn: Defense Express reports that Russia is developing a surface-to-air missile to intercept drones based on the unguided 82.5 mm Alazan-6 anti-hail rocket.
